Relate the AI methodologies of knowledge representation in right match.
a. NLP
b. Representation in structured network
c. Classes in ontology
d. Expert system
(i) Inference engine
(ii) Abstract categories of related topics/concepts
(iii) Semantic network
(iv) Semantic analysis

options.A: a – iv, b – iii, c – ii, d – i
options.B: a – iv, b – ii, c – iii, d – i
options.C: a – iii, b – iv, c – ii, d – i
options.D: a – i, b – ii, c – iii, d – iv

questions.explanation: NLP uses semantic analysis; a structured network is a semantic network; ontology classes are abstract categories; expert systems have inference engines. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: If f(x) = x is my friend, and P(x) = x is perfect, then the correct logical translation of the statement "Some of my friends are not perfect" is ____.
questions.explanation: 'Some' is ∃ with ∧: there is someone who is my friend and not perfect. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Given two Fuzzy sets A and B with membership function μA(x) = {0.6, 0.5, 0.1, 0.7, 0.8}, μB(x) = {0.9, 0.2, 0.6, 0.8, 0.5}. Now calculate the value of μ(A ∪ B)′(x).
questions.explanation: Union = max = {0.9, 0.5, 0.6, 0.8, 0.8}; complement = 1 − μ = {0.1, 0.5, 0.4, 0.2, 0.2}. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Backpropagation Neural Network is a technique used for:

options.A: Transmission of error back through the network to adjust the inputs
options.B: Updating weights based on error propagation

Match the following 'Heuristic Search' with respect to "Hill climbing" Algorithm:

c. Plateau
d. Ridge

(ii) Gradient search
(iii) Area higher than surrounding
(iv) Flat area of the search space

options.A: a – ii, b – i, c – iv, d – iii
options.B: a – i, b – iv, c – iii, d – ii

questions.question:
Let the population of chromosomes in Genetic Algorithm is represented in terms of binary number. The strength of fitness of a chromosome in decimal form, x, is given by Sf(x) = f(x) / Σf(x) where f(x) = x².
The population is P = {(01101), (11000), (01000), (10011)}.
Calculate the strength of fitness of chromosome (11000).
questions.explanation: x = 13, 24, 8, 19 → f = 169, 576, 64, 361, total 1170; 576 / 1170 ≈ 49.2%. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)
